dsh-plugin-qr-connect 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

posts.en:
dsh-plugin-qr-connect is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-31d69ec6190881f65b8a.html
